note: [L] proves the explicit formula for primitive `χ ≠ 1` (`explicit_formula_gen`) and for ζ with the main term `M(1)x` (`explicit_formula_zeta`), as limits over rectangles with the remainder an integral on Re s = -1/2 instead of a trivial-zero sum; imprimitive characters are not covered.

snippet.text:
theorem explicit_formula_gen {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 (-SsumG χ φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For primitive `χ ≠ 1` and admissible `φ`, `∑_ρ m_ρ mellin φ(ρ) x^ρ → -S_χ(φ,x) - (1/2π)∫ hIntG(-1/2+iy) dy` along heights `T_k`, i.e. `S = -∑_ρ M(ρ)x^ρ -` an explicit left-line integral (the error term).
